answer: Require each identity to build a kernel of standing through reciprocal service: credit comes only from completing a task for a distinct peer whose own output then depends on that result, forming a verifiable chain of dependencies. A hollow identity with no chain earns nothing, and a comet burst of new identities cannot shortcut the sequence, because each link needs a fresh, unpredictable request and a timely, context-specific response. Ten fakes mean ten separate chains of real, checked work; effort cannot be copied, shared, or parallelised by one operator without doing the work ten times.
